items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And then I became very close with Alan Dooley Wilson and his wife.

ctx.x: And we came home and my dog was almost dead. And I went around the corner and told the woman, the only way you could get the house was to buy her furnishings. And I told her I would buy her furnishings and we were ready to move in that day. And we moved in. And the woman stayed with us for about three months but she was nice. Very nice a lovely person. And Dorothy Mundy told me I wouldn't like living with a stranger. I told her I can live with anybody. I get along with anybody. And found out the woman was a…

friends. And so when it was time, when Zutty's, Zutty could have left Billy Berg's he said we'll go back to New York. I said, no, I like California (LAUGHTER). And then I became very close with Alan Dooley Wilson and his wife. He lived across the street.
